about: The gradual of the Annunciation of the Blessed Virgin Mary in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grace has been poured out upon your lips; therefore God has blessed you forever. For the sake of truth and meekness and justice; and your right hand will lead you wondrously.

ex.w013: The chant selects only this opening phrase of the Psalm verse before the next clause. No verb is expressed here.
